_comment: graphify hooks. The installer hardcodes an absolute path (/root/.local/bin/graphify) that only exists on the machine it ran on. These resolve graphify from PATH instead and exit 0 when it is not installed, so a teammate without graphify is never blocked from reading or searching. Install it with: pip install graphifyy

hooks.command: command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 && graphify hook-guard search || exit 0
command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 && graphify hook-guard read || exit 0
